decisions: The existing 43-table schema is a validated pipeline/runtime model, not the Java workbench domain model.
Question collections and their snapshots are first-class because the prototype proves they are immutable workflow boundaries.
Knowledge content is versioned separately from taxonomy labels because editor references pin knowledge revisions.
Export requests are immutable; retries create new processing jobs and retain retry lineage.
An outbox is deferred until a real cross-process delivery contract exists.
